label: common_0060_head_teacher_00
text: Right then, dear Pokémon. Time to come out of\nyour Poké Balls.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_kari_01
text: [EMPTY 23]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_01
text: We provide each student entering the academy\na Pokémon of their own.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_02
text: I’ll ask you to choose which among these three\nyou’d like to have as your partner.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_07
text: Sprigatito, the Grass Cat Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_poke_a_01
text: Sprrr.

label: common_0060_head_teacher_08
text: Fuecoco, the Fire Croc Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_poke_b_01
text: Craaaw?

label: common_0060_head_teacher_09
text: And Quaxly, the Duckling Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_poke_c_01
text: Pomp!

label: common_0060_head_teacher_10
text: They’re all very good company. Why, they usually\nrefuse to even leave my side.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_11
text: What’s this?[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hmm. So it turns out they’re more interested in
you, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)], than
familiar
old me.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_04
text: I do wish I could stay and see which one you’ll\nchoose, but I must be off to my next home visit...[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_05
text: I’ll be at the house just over there. Take your time\nwith your decision, then come find me once your\r\nmind is made up.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_head_teacher_06
text: Now if you’ll excuse me. Until next we meet.[VAR 0x0114(000A)]

label: common_0060_mama_01
text: What a mannerly fellow that director of yours is![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0060_mama_02
text: These three are all lovely—but you need to\nchoose just one, right? Not an easy task![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0060_mama_03
text: Why not take this opportunity to walk about with\nthese little ones and get to know them?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0060_mama_04
text: I’m sure they have lots to teach you![VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0060_mama_05
text: Oh! But before you go... I got you a little\nsomething to celebrate your big day!\c\nTake it with you if you’re going out on your own.[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0060_mama_06
text:
It’s a brand-new phone!\c
According to the instructions, you can check the
map app by pressing the [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Y Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].\c
It’ll help keep you from getting lost, so take
good care of your new gadget, OK?[VAR 0x0114(002B)]

label: common_0060_mama_07
text: Now off you go. Have fun![VAR 0x0114(002B)]
